note: Every source COP shows, with its licence and whether a paid COP could use it (Tom, 31 Oct 2026: a paid tier is possible later). commercial_ok is true, false or unknown; basis says why. The free public picture uses everything; the flag drives nothing yet. snapshot.py lists any source id seen in a feed but missing here as unregistered, so a new upstream (for example a non-commercial one) can't slip into a paid tier unnoticed. Tom reviews every value before anyone pays.
